mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.tenant_application(tenant_id,application_id,environment,created_by) VALUES(#{p.tenantId},#{p.applicationId},#{p.environment},#{operator}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT enabled FROM auth_governance.tenant_application WHERE FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.access_delegation(tenant_id,application_id,environment,membership_id,generation,capabilities_json,max_duration_seconds,created_by) VALUES(#{p.tenantId},#{p.applicationId},#{p.environment},#{d.membershipId},#{d.generation},#{d.capabilitiesJson},#{d.maxDurationSeconds},#{operator}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT membership_id,generation,capabilities_json,max_duration_seconds FROM auth_governance.access_delegation WHERE AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation} AND enabled=true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.role_version(id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,role_code,version,capabilities_json,content_hash,created_by) VALUES(#{r.id},#{r.tenantId},#{r.applicationId},#{r.environment},#{r.roleCode},#{r.version},#{r.capabilitiesJson},#{r.contentHash},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_governance.role_version WHERE AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.role_version WHERE AND role_code=#{code} AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.access_grant(id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,membership_id,generation,role_id,scope,source_type,source_id,valid_from,valid_to,state,version,created_by,group_id) VALUES(#{g.id},#{g.tenantId},#{g.applicationId},#{g.environment},#{g.membershipId},#{g.generation},#{g.roleId},#{g.scope},#{g.sourceType},#{g.sourceId},#{g.validFrom},#{g.validTo},#{g.state},#{g.version},#{actor},#{g.groupId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT rule_json FROM auth_governance.grant_scope WHERE AND grant_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_grant WHERE AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.access_grant SET state='REVOKED',version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.access_grant WHERE AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation} AND state IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE') AND valid_to > clock_timestamp()

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.id=#{member} AND m.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND m.generation=#{generation} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > clock_timestamp()))
SELECT FROM auth_governance.role_version WHERE AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 101
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_grant WHERE AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 101
